summary: Backend (26 tests: 20 unit + 6 e2e) and Frontend E2E all pass. Login->Dashboard->Projects (create), Scans (queue+poll), ScanDetail (findings load, evidence panel, export buttons present), Findings page all functional. Scan against http://localhost:5000/ completes in ~2-4s and yields >=5 findings covering html/attribute/javascript/encoded contexts including POST /form. Exports JSON/CSV/MD return correct content-types with non-empty bodies. Dashboard summary returns numeric counts.
critical_code_review_comments: Findings page (Findings.jsx) does no loading indicator; if fetch is slow or fails silently it shows 'No findings yet' with no distinction. Consider a loading/error state.
backend/.env still contains legacy MONGO_URL/DB_NAME keys unrelated to this project (SQLite is used). Harmless but confusing.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* projects and scans against http://localhost:5000/ via e2e tests and UI walkthrough.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test target Flask app must be running on localhost:5000. Backend embedded worker (RUN_EMBEDDED_WORKER=true) drains QUEUED scans. Scans complete quickly (~2s). Login endpoint is POST /api/auth/login-json returning access_token. Existing pytest at /app/tests/test_scanner_core.py (20 unit tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_api_e2e.py (6 e2e tests) — both fully green.
